c: Dry-roast whole spices 2–4 min until fragrant and a shade darker; cool; grind with turmeric.
Cut breadfruit in 3 cm cubes; keep in salted water (it browns).
Fry curry leaves and pandan in coconut oil; onion 8 min; garlic, ginger and curry powder 2 min.
Add breadfruit, water and coconut milk; simmer 15–20 min until tender but whole.
f39d7b95.al: None of the 14 declared allergens. Vegan.

2aa81e99.yl: Yield: 10 portions · 30 pcs · Portion: 3 pcs ≈ 150 g
c: Sweat sliced onion, curry leaves and chilli 3 min; add shredded cabbage and turmeric, cook 5 min until soft but dry.
Mix in flaked tuna and egg; season; cool to 4 °C.
Cut pastry in strips; fold into triangles around 30 g filling; seal with flour paste.
Fry at 170 °C 3–4 min until golden and crisp; drain. Oil weight = absorbed.
Serve warm with black tea; hold at 63 °C or above, max 2 h.
2aa81e99.al: 1 Gluten (spring roll pastry, wheat flour) · 3 Eggs (eggs) · 4 Fish (tuna in brine)

8803f28d.yl: Yield: 10 portions · Portion: 180 g raw fillet ≈ 200 g served
c: Soak chillies in hot water 20 min; drain.
Blend everything to a thick, smooth paste.
Cut 10 × 180 g skin-on portions; score the skin 3 times.
Rub paste into the cuts and all over; marinate 30–60 min at 0–4 °C (longer and the lime starts to cook the fish).
Oil the bars; grill over medium-hot charcoal skin side first 4–5 min, turn once, 3–4 min; core 63 °C.
Serve with lime; traditionally with rice, roshi or a cabbage-coconut salad.
8803f28d.st: Paste: 0–4 °C, 5 days. Marinated fish: 0–4 °C, max 2 h.
8803f28d.al: 4 Fish (grouper / job fish fillet). Whole fish or tuna steaks can be used the same way.

d9477dd6.yl: Yield: 10 portions · Portion: 300 g broth and fish + 150 g rice + garnish ≈ 490 g
c: Batch · Yield ≈ 3000 g (2000 g broth + 1000 g fish)
Cut tuna into 5 cm pieces on the bone; rinse in cold water until it runs clear (no blood = clear broth).
Cover with cold water, add salt, onion and curry leaves; bring up slowly.
Skim all scum continuously; clarity is the quality mark.
Simmer 10–12 min only, until the fish is just cooked; lift the fish, strain broth through muslin.
Serve the fish in the broth at 75 °C or above.
Rinse until clear; absorption method 18 min covered on low; rest 10 min; fluff.
Serve fish and broth in a bowl, rice on the side.
Lime wedges, sliced red onion and chilli in small dishes; the guest mixes rice into the broth.
Optional: rihaakuru (tuna paste) on the side.
d9477dd6.st: Broth: 0–4 °C, 48 h (cool fast, \<2 h to 10 °C). Cooked fish: 0–4 °C, 24 h. Rice: 0–4 °C, 24 h.

4f86f4b1.yl: Yield: 10 portions · 60 pcs · Portion: 6 pcs ≈ 150 g
c: Chop onion, chilli, ginger and curry leaves very finely.
Mix with flaked smoked tuna, coconut, lime and salt; knead by hand until it holds together.
Knead to a smooth, firm dough 5 min; rest covered 20 min.
Flatten 12.5 g dough to 6 cm; place filling, close and roll into a smooth ball with no cracks (cracks burst in the oil).
Deep-fry at 170 °C 5–6 min, turning, until deep golden.
Drain on paper; serve warm with black tea; hold at 63 °C or above, max 2 h.
4f86f4b1.st: Raw shaped gulha: 0–4 °C, 24 h; −18 °C, 1 month (fry from frozen at 160 °C).
4f86f4b1.al: 1 Gluten (wheat flour) · 4 Fish (smoked tuna or kingfish). Oil weight = absorbed oil.

a374ea46.yl: Yield: 10 portions · Portion: 280 g (serve with rice or roshi)
c: Dry-roast whole spices 2–4 min until fragrant and a shade darker; cool; grind with turmeric.
Cut legs into 2 pieces; rub with salt and 15 g curry powder; 30 min at 0–4 °C.
Fry curry leaves, pandan and cinnamon in coconut oil; add onion, cook 10 min golden; add garlic and ginger 2 min.
Add remaining curry powder and chilli 1 min, tomatoes 5 min; add chicken and turn to coat 5 min.
Add water and coconut milk; simmer covered 30–35 min until tender, core 75 °C; finish with lime.

051478d6.yl: Yield: 10 portions · 1 tray 30 × 20 cm · Portion: 1 square ≈ 120 g
c: Chop onion, chilli, ginger and curry leaves finely; fry in half the coconut oil 3 min.
Mix with flaked tuna, coconut, rice flour, water, lime, turmeric and salt to a thick batter.
Spread 3 cm in an oiled tray; brush top with remaining oil.
Bake 180 °C 35–40 min until golden and firm; cool 10 min; cut 10 squares.
051478d6.st: 0–4 °C, 48 h; serve warm or room temperature.

c: Shred cabbage very fine; slice onion and chilli thin; dice cucumber.
Rub onion and chilli with salt and lime by hand 1 min.
Toss with cabbage, coconut, cucumber and chopped curry leaves just before service; serve at 4–8 °C.
749ade97.st: Cut vegetables: 0–4 °C, 24 h. Dress to order.
749ade97.al: None of the 14 declared allergens. Vegan.

116127e7.yl: Yield: 10 portions · Portion: 80 g mas huni + 2 roshi ≈ 180 g
c: Chop onion, chilli and curry leaves very finely.
Rub them with salt and lime by hand for 1 min to release the juices (traditional hand-mixing).
Add the flaked tuna and coconut; mix by hand until moist and evenly combined.
Taste: salty, hot and sour. Hold at 0–4 °C, serve within 2 h.
Mix flours and salt; add hot water (60 °C) and oil; knead 5 min until smooth.
Cover and rest 30 min; divide 20 × 50 g; roll 18 cm, very thin.
Cook on a dry flat-top at 220 °C, 40–60 s per side, until brown spots appear; press the edges so it puffs.
Stack in a cloth to keep soft.
Serve 80 g mas huni with 2 warm roshi and a lime wedge; Maldivian breakfast with black tea.
116127e7.st: Mas huni: 0–4 °C, 24 h. Roshi dough: 0–4 °C, 24 h; cooked roshi: same day.
116127e7.al: 1 Gluten (wholemeal flour, wheat flour) · 4 Fish (tuna in brine). Classic version uses smoked or fresh-boiled tuna; adjust salt.

7c3da7e0.yl: Yield: 10 portions · Portion: 250 g curry (serve with rice or roshi)
c: Dry-roast whole spices separately on low heat 2–4 min until fragrant and a shade darker; do not burn.
Cool, grind fine with turmeric; keep airtight.
Cut tuna into 3 cm cubes; toss with salt, turmeric and 10 g curry powder; 20 min at 0–4 °C.
Heat coconut oil; fry curry leaves, pandan, cinnamon and cardamom 30 s.
Add sliced onion, cook 8–10 min until golden; add garlic and ginger 2 min.
Add remaining curry powder and chilli, 1 min on low; add tomatoes 5 min.
Add water and coconut milk; simmer 10 min to a coating sauce.
Add tuna; simmer gently 6–8 min until just cooked (tuna dries fast); finish with lime.
7c3da7e0.st: Curry powder: airtight, 1 month. Curry: 0–4 °C, 48 h; reheat to 75 °C once.

0e30df1b.yl: Yield: 10 portions · Portion: 300 g raw steak ≈ 300 g served with sauce
c: Ageing: bone-in rib on racks, 28–35 days at 1–3 °C, 75–85 % RH, constant airflow; trim the dry crust (25–35 % loss with evaporation).
Cut 10 × 300 g steaks, 3.5 cm thick; temper 30 min; salt just before grilling.
Grill on the hottest zone 3–4 min per side, turning 90° for a crosshatch; finish on the indirect zone to core 52–54 °C (medium-rare).
Baste with butter, garlic and thyme; rest 5 min.
Reduce vinegar, wine, shallots, tarragon stalks and crushed pepper to 30 ml; strain.
Whisk yolks with the reduction over a bain-marie to 65–70 °C, thick ribbon.
Whisk in butter slowly; season; add chopped tarragon. Hold at 60–63 °C, max 2 h.
Slice or serve whole; béarnaise in a small pot.
3 g of each salt on a board: fleur de sel (clean crunch, beef), smoked (lean cuts, fish), black lava (mineral, seafood); explain at the table.
0e30df1b.st: Raw steaks: 0–2 °C, 72 h. Béarnaise: make per service, discard after 2 h.
0e30df1b.al: 3 Eggs (egg yolks) · 7 Milk (butter) · 14 Sulphites (white wine vinegar, white wine). Check wine label for 14 Sulphites.

a72abb2b.yl: Yield: 10 portions · Portion: ½ lobster ≈ 480 g in shell with butter
c: Fry curry leaves crisp in 20 g of the butter; cool; chop.
Beat soft butter with grated garlic, lime juice and zest, chopped parsley, chilli, curry leaves and salt.
Chill live lobsters in an ice slurry 20–30 min to sedate; split lengthwise, head first, with a heavy knife.
Remove stomach sac and intestinal tract; crack the legs (spiny lobster has no big claws).
Brush with butter; grill flesh side down 3–4 min on high heat, turn shell side down, baste 4–5 min until opaque; core 60–63 °C.
Finish with more butter and lime; serve at once.
a72abb2b.st: Live lobster: 6–10 °C, damp cover, max 24 h. Butter: 0–4 °C, 7 days.

c: Roast shells and heads (stomach sac removed) 200 °C 15 min until red; crush.
Sweat vegetables in butter 8 min; add tomato paste 2 min; add shells; flambé with brandy; deglaze with wine.
Add tomatoes, water, rice and tarragon stalks; simmer 45 min.
Blend briefly, pass through a chinois pressing hard, then through a fine sieve.
Reduce to 2.3 kg; add cream; season; froth with a hand blender to serve, 75 °C or above.
bbe37568.al: 2 Crustaceans (lobster shells & heads) · 7 Milk (cream 35%, butter) · 9 Celery (celery) · 14 Sulphites (white wine). Check wine label for 14 Sulphites.

ecc62cf3.yl: Yield: 10 portions (5 platters for two) · Portion: ≈ 420 g in shell
c: Simmer 15 min; poach prawns 2–3 min, crab 12–15 min (whole), mussels 3 min covered; chill at once in iced water.
Chill salt bricks in the freezer 2 h; set on crushed ice on the platter.
Tuna tartare: 5 mm dice, chives, salt, lime; scallops raw sliced (or seared 30 s per side).
Shuck oysters to order; check smell and that they are alive (tight shell).
Arrange: crab halves, prawns, mussels, oysters, tuna, scallops; lemon, mignonette (shallot + vinegar) and mayo.
Platter leaves the kitchen at 0–4 °C; max 1 h on the table.
ecc62cf3.st: Cooked shellfish: 0–4 °C, 24 h. Live oysters: 2–6 °C, cupped side down, damp cover; keep labels.
ecc62cf3.al: 2 Crustaceans (blue swimmer crab, tiger prawns) · 3 Eggs (mayonnaise) · 4 Fish (tuna loin) · 12 Molluscs (oysters, green mussels, scallops) · 14 Sulphites (red wine vinegar). Mussels, oysters and scallops = 12 Molluscs.

101482cb.yl: Yield: 10 portions · Portion: 1 fish 500 g gutted ≈ 450 g served
c: Blend herbs, garlic and chilli with oil 30 s; add lime and salt.
Scale, trim fins, score 3 cuts each side to the bone; salt inside and out.
Oil the fish and the clean, hot bars (or use a fish cage).
Grill on medium-high 6–8 min per side, turn once; done when the flesh lifts from the spine, core 63 °C.
Spoon herb oil over; serve with lime.
101482cb.st: Raw fish: on ice 0–2 °C, 48 h. Herb oil: 0–4 °C, 48 h.

eb024828.yl: Yield: 10 portions · Portion: ≈ 165 g (100 g tuna)
c: Slice 1.5 mm on a mandoline; rinse and dry well.
Fry at 160 °C 3–4 min until golden; drain; salt. Oil weight = absorbed.
Whisk all; grate the ginger; keep at 0–4 °C.
Keep tuna at 0–2 °C; cut on a chilled board into 5 mm dice.
Mix tuna with shallot, chives and sesame oil; dress at the last moment (lime 'cooks' the fish).
Ring: 30 g diced avocado, 100 g tuna; spoon dressing around; crisps on the side. Serve at 2–4 °C.
eb024828.st: Cut tuna: 0–2 °C, serve within 2 h. Crisps: airtight, 24 h.
eb024828.al: 1 Gluten (soy sauce) · 4 Fish (tuna loin) · 6 Soybeans (soy sauce) · 11 Sesame (toasted sesame oil). Gluten-free option: tamari.

420b3165.yl: Yield: 10 portions · 30 arancini × 80 g · Portion: 3 pcs + 30 g dip
c: Classic risotto, slightly firm; spread 2 cm on a tray; chill overnight (holds shape).
Shape 60 g rice around a cube of mozzarella and a few peas; 30 balls.
Flour, egg, breadcrumbs (twice for a firm shell); chill 30 min.
Fry 170 °C 5–6 min to golden, 75 °C core (oil weight = absorbed). Serve with warm tomato dip.
420b3165.al: 1 Gluten (breadcrumbs, wheat flour) · 3 Eggs (eggs) · 7 Milk (parmesan, butter, mozzarella) · 9 Celery (chicken stock) · 14 Sulphites (white wine)

9e3d63eb.yl: Yield: 10 portions · Portion: 1 burrata 125 g + 200 g tomatoes ≈ 350 g
c: Burrata out of the fridge 30 min before service (cold mutes flavour); drain.
Cut tomatoes in wedges and slices of mixed colours; season with flaky salt 5 min before plating.
Plate tomatoes, burrata in the centre, torn basil, olive oil, a few drops of balsamic, pepper.
9e3d63eb.st: Burrata 0–4 °C, by date; once opened same day.

c: Mix flours, 700 g water and yeast; add salt and rest of water; 50 g oil; stretch-and-fold 4 × every 20 min.
Oil the tray (50 g); stretch dough to the corners in 2–3 rests; proof 1.5–2 h.
Dimple with oiled fingers; brine of 100 g water, 10 g salt, 50 g oil on top; rosemary, flaky salt.
Bake 240 °C 18–20 min, golden; brush with oil out of the oven; cool on a rack.
795835de.st: Day of baking; 0 °C not advised. Freeze par-baked, −18 °C, 1 month.

a0e2b911.yl: Yield: 10 portions · Portion: 220 g fried + 35 g aioli
c: Crush garlic with salt; whisk with yolks; oil in a thin stream; lemon to finish.
Squid in rings, zucchini in batons; pat everything dry.
Toss in semolina-flour mix; shake off excess in a sieve.
Fry 180 °C in small batches 1.5–2 min (squid tough if longer); drain, salt at once.
Serve straight away with lemon and aioli.
a0e2b911.al: 1 Gluten (durum semolina, tipo 00 flour) · 2 Crustaceans (black tiger prawns) · 3 Eggs (egg yolks) · 4 Fish (whitebait / small reef fish) · 12 Molluscs (squid)

cd3b64c3.yl: Yield: 10 portions · Portion: 220 g gnocchi + sauce & cheese ≈ 380 g
c: Bake potatoes whole on salt 200 °C 60 min (dry flesh, less flour); peel hot; rice (2 kg → 1.7 kg).
Work in flour, yolks, Parmesan and salt briefly while warm; do not knead.
Roll 2 cm ropes, cut 2.5 cm; gnocchi board; semolina tray.
Tomato sauce: garlic in oil, tomatoes, 20 min, basil (≈ 1.5 kg).
Boil gnocchi until they float + 30 s; fold into sauce.
Into terracotta dishes, mozzarella and Parmesan on top; 230 °C 5–6 min until bubbling; basil.
cd3b64c3.st: Raw gnocchi: freeze on trays, −18 °C, 1 month.
cd3b64c3.al: 1 Gluten (tipo 00 flour) · 3 Eggs (egg yolks) · 7 Milk (parmesan, mozzarella fior di latte)

6e77b19e.yl: Yield: 10 portions · Portion: ≈ 380 g with ½ lobster
c: Split 5 lobsters (sedated in ice); cut each half in 3 pieces in the shell.
Cook linguine in salted water (10 g/L) 2 min less than the pack.
Sear lobster in olive oil 2 min; add garlic, chilli, halved tomatoes 2 min; wine, reduce; add bisque.
Add pasta and a ladle of cooking water; toss 2 min until glossy; finish with butter and parsley.
6e77b19e.al: 1 Gluten (linguine) · 2 Crustaceans (spiny lobster, lobster bisque) · 7 Milk (lobster bisque, butter) · 9 Celery (lobster bisque) · 14 Sulphites (white wine, lobster bisque). Check wine label for 14 Sulphites. Bisque base: see TTK 23.

c: Slice aubergine 8 mm; salt 30 min; press dry.
Fry 175 °C until golden (or brush and bake 220 °C for lighter); drain (3 kg → 1.8 kg).
Sauce: garlic in olive oil, passata 30 min, basil.
Layer sauce, aubergine, mozzarella, Parmesan, basil × 4; finish with sauce and Parmesan.
Bake 180 °C 40 min; rest 30 min before cutting into 10.
734e31a9.st: 0–4 °C, 72 h; reheat to 75 °C. Better on day 2.

c: Dice vegetables 1 cm; soffritto of onion, carrot, celery, garlic in oil 10 min.
Add potatoes, tomatoes, stock; simmer 15 min; zucchini, cavolo nero, beans 10 min.
Ditalini 8 min in the soup; season.
Serve with a spoon of pesto and Parmesan.
ad5c5f68.st: 0–4 °C, 72 h without pasta (cook pasta separately for holding).
ad5c5f68.al: 1 Gluten (ditalini) · 7 Milk (basil pesto, parmesan) · 8 Nuts (basil pesto) · 9 Celery (vegetable stock, celery). Vegan option: no pesto and Parmesan, olive oil instead.

72c68453.yl: Yield: 10 portions · Portion: 130 g fresh pasta + 220 g ragù ≈ 390 g plated
c: Well of flour and semolina; eggs in the centre; work 10 min to a smooth, firm dough.
Wrap; rest 30 min at room temperature (gluten relaxes).
Laminate to setting 6–7 (1 mm), fold and pass 3 times at the start.
Batch · 2.5 kg raw cheeks → ≈ 2.2 kg sauce
Season and sear cheeks hard; soffritto 10 min; tomato paste 2 min; deglaze wine, reduce by half.
Add passata, stock, herbs; braise covered 150 °C 3–3.5 h until a spoon cuts it (raw 2.5 kg → 1.25 kg meat).
Shred meat into the reduced liquid; season.
Cut pappardelle 2.5 cm wide; dust with semolina.
Boil 2–3 min; toss in ragù with butter and a splash of pasta water until glossy.
Plate; Parmesan; gremolata of parsley, lemon zest and garlic.
72c68453.st: Ragù: 0–4 °C, 4 days. Pasta sheets: 0–4 °C, 24 h; −18 °C, 1 month.
72c68453.al: 1 Gluten (tipo 00 flour, durum semolina) · 3 Eggs (eggs, egg yolks) · 7 Milk (parmesan, butter) · 9 Celery (beef stock, celery) · 14 Sulphites (red wine)

ce2f97e3.yl: Yield: 10 portions · Portion: 100 g dry pasta ≈ 320 g plated
c: Garlic slices and crushed chilli in oil on low heat until garlic is pale gold.
Add crushed tomatoes; simmer 20 min; season (sauce ≈ 1.4 kg).
Cook penne 1 min short; finish 1 min in the sauce with pasta water; parsley and oil to finish.

2572a1e4.yl: Yield: 10 portions · Portion: 160 g fish + 140 g broth & tomatoes ≈ 300 g
c: Portion fish 180 g skin-on; salt 10 min before cooking.
Garlic and chilli in oil; halved tomatoes 3 min until they burst; wine, water, olives, capers; simmer 5 min.
Lay fish in, skin up; cover; poach 6–8 min to 60 °C core (180 g → 160 g).
Serve in a deep plate with the broth; parsley, raw olive oil, grilled bread.
2572a1e4.al: 4 Fish (grouper / job fish fillet) · 14 Sulphites (white wine)

e3c1493a.yl: Yield: 10 pizzas Ø 30 cm · Portion: 1 pizza ≈ 410 g
c: Mix flour and 90 % of the water; autolyse 20 min. Add yeast, salt, rest of water, then oil.
Knead 10–12 min to smooth, dough temperature 23–24 °C; bulk 2 h at room temperature.
Ball 250 g; boxes, lidded; 72 h at 4 °C. Out 2–3 h before use (15–17 °C core).
Crush tomatoes by hand or pass through a food mill (no blender: aerates and turns orange); season. Raw, not cooked.
Drain torn mozzarella in a sieve 1 h at 0–4 °C (dry pizza).
Stretch by hand from the centre out, leave a 1.5 cm rim (cornicione); no rolling pin.
Sauce 80 g, mozzarella 100 g, salami 50 g; bake 430–450 °C 70–90 s (deck oven 300 °C 5–6 min).
Finish with chilli oil and basil.
e3c1493a.st: Dough balls: 4 °C, use day 3–4. Sauce: 0–4 °C, 48 h.
e3c1493a.al: 1 Gluten (tipo 00 flour) · 7 Milk (mozzarella fior di latte) · 14 Sulphites (spicy salami). Halal option: beef salami.

d5ecde0e.yl: Yield: 10 pizzas Ø 30 cm · Portion: 1 pizza ≈ 400 g
c: Mix flour and 90 % of the water; autolyse 20 min. Add yeast, salt, rest of water, then oil.
Knead 10–12 min to smooth, dough temperature 23–24 °C; bulk 2 h at room temperature.
Ball 250 g; boxes, lidded; 72 h at 4 °C. Out 2–3 h before use (15–17 °C core).
Crush tomatoes by hand or pass through a food mill (no blender: aerates and turns orange); season. Raw, not cooked.
Cut squid in rings; toss seafood with garlic, oil and chilli 15 min at 0–4 °C.
Stretch; sauce only, bake 45 s; add seafood, bake 45–60 s more (seafood stays juicy).
Parsley, olive oil, lemon wedge. No cheese, as in Naples.
d5ecde0e.al: 1 Gluten (tipo 00 flour) · 2 Crustaceans (black tiger prawns) · 12 Molluscs (squid, mussel meat)

a68851a4.yl: Yield: 10 pizzas · Portion: 1 pizza 30 cm ≈ 420 g
c: Dissolve yeast in cold water; mix with flour 5 min; add salt; knead 10 min to 24–26 °C dough.
Bulk 2 h at room temperature; ball 250 g; 48 h at 4 °C in covered trays.
Out of the fridge 3–4 h before service.
Crush tomatoes by hand with salt (no cooking).
Open the ball from the centre out by hand, keep a 2 cm rim (cornicione).
90 g tomato, 100 g torn, well-drained mozzarella; oil.
Bake on stone 400–450 °C 90 s (wood oven) or 300 °C 5–6 min; basil after baking.
a68851a4.al: 1 Gluten (tipo 00 flour) · 7 Milk (mozzarella fior di latte)

903e0ad4.yl: Yield: 10 portions · Portion: 1 cutlet ≈ 200 g + 80 g salad
c: Butterfly and pound breasts to 8 mm, even thickness (180 g each).
Flour, egg, breadcrumbs mixed with Parmesan; press well.
Pan-fry in clarified butter 170 °C 3 min per side to golden, 75 °C core; drain; salt.
Top with dressed rocket and tomatoes; lemon wedge.
903e0ad4.al: 1 Gluten (breadcrumbs, wheat flour) · 3 Eggs (eggs) · 7 Milk (clarified butter, parmesan) · 14 Sulphites (balsamic vinegar)

03f23dc8.yl: Yield: 10 portions · 100 ravioli · Portion: 10 pcs ≈ 250 g
c: Drain ricotta overnight at 0–4 °C. Blanch spinach, squeeze very dry, chop (800 g → 300 g).
Pasta dough of flour and eggs, rest 30 min; sheet 0.8 mm.
Pipe 15 g filling, cover, press out air, cut 5 cm squares; semolina tray.
Boil 3 min; toss in foaming butter with sage leaves and pasta water; Parmesan.
03f23dc8.st: Raw ravioli: 0–4 °C, 24 h; freeze on trays, −18 °C, 1 month, cook from frozen.
03f23dc8.al: 1 Gluten (tipo 00 flour) · 3 Eggs (eggs) · 7 Milk (ricotta, parmesan, butter)

c: Steam mussels and clams open with half the wine; pick most meat, keep 20 in shell; strain the juice into the stock.
Toast rice dry 2 min with shallot and oil (tostatura); deglaze with rest of wine.
Add hot stock a ladle at a time, 16–17 min, stirring.
Last 3 min: squid, prawns, diced tomato; then shellfish.
Off heat: mantecatura with butter and olive oil, 1 min rest; all'onda (flows on the plate). Parsley, lemon zest. No Parmesan.
1b0c0f06.st: Par-cooked risotto (12 min, spread thin, chilled): 0–4 °C, 24 h; finish to order.
1b0c0f06.al: 2 Crustaceans (black tiger prawns) · 4 Fish (fish stock) · 7 Milk (butter) · 12 Molluscs (mussels, clams, squid) · 14 Sulphites (white wine)

f57023a9.yl: Yield: 10 portions · Portion: 100 g dry pasta ≈ 320 g plated (cook 2 portions per pan)
c: Cut guanciale in 1 cm lardons; render slowly in a dry pan 8–10 min until crisp edges; keep the fat.
Whisk yolks, eggs, two-thirds of the pecorino and toasted, cracked pepper to a paste.
Boil spaghetti in lightly salted water (pecorino is salty) 1 min short of al dente.
Off heat: pasta into the guanciale pan, toss, cool 30 s; add egg mix and pasta water, toss to a cream at 65–70 °C (no scrambling).
Plate; rest of pecorino and pepper. No cream.
f57023a9.st: Egg mix: 0–4 °C, service only. Cook to order.
f57023a9.al: 1 Gluten (spaghetti) · 3 Eggs (egg yolks, eggs) · 7 Milk (pecorino romano). Halal option: beef bacon instead of guanciale.

3536d035.yl: Yield: 10 portions · Portion: 100 g dry pasta + 250 g clams in shell ≈ 380 g
c: Purge clams 2 h in cold salted water (35 g/L); discard open ones that do not close when tapped.
Garlic and chilli in oil; clams and wine, lid on, 2–3 min until open; discard closed ones; strain and keep juice.
Spaghetti 2 min short; finish in the clam juice, tossing hard to emulsify with oil; clams and parsley back in. No cheese.
3536d035.st: Live clams 2–4 °C, damp cloth, not in water or sealed bags; use within 2 days. Keep shellfish tags 60 days.

6710b7f7.yl: Yield: 10 portions · Portion: 130 g fresh pasta + 200 g ragù ≈ 370 g plated
c: Well of flour and semolina; eggs in the centre; work 10 min to a smooth, firm dough.
Wrap; rest 30 min at room temperature (gluten relaxes).
Laminate to setting 6–7 (1 mm), fold and pass 3 times at the start.
Render diced pancetta; soffritto (fine dice) 15 min, soft not brown.
Add mince, cook until it sizzles and browns; white wine, reduce.
Milk, reduce (softens the meat); tomato paste, passata and stock.
Simmer very low 2.5–3 h, topping up with stock; season.
Cut tagliatelle 7–8 mm; boil 2 min; toss with ragù, butter and pasta water; Parmesan at the table.
6710b7f7.al: 1 Gluten (tipo 00 flour, durum semolina) · 3 Eggs (eggs, egg yolks) · 7 Milk (milk 3%, butter, parmesan) · 9 Celery (beef stock, celery) · 14 Sulphites (white wine). Halal option: beef only, no pancetta.

82048a0b.yl: Yield: 10 portions · Portion: 100 g veal + 70 g sauce ≈ 180 g
c: Tie meat; simmer gently in the court-bouillon to 58–60 °C core (≈ 45 min); cool in the liquid; chill.
Blend tuna, capers, anchovies and lemon; fold into mayonnaise; loosen with cold poaching stock.
Plate veal overlapping, coat with sauce; caper berries on top.
82048a0b.al: 3 Eggs (mayonnaise) · 4 Fish (tuna in olive oil, anchovy fillets) · 9 Celery (celery) · 14 Sulphites (white wine)

3aa0256a.yl: Yield: 10 portions · Portion: 5 prawns ≈ 180 g with sauce
c: Bring to the boil, cool; serve warm 50 °C.
Score the belly 3–4 times and press flat so prawns stay straight; dry well.
Mix flour and ice water with chopsticks just 10 s; lumps are fine (no gluten = crisp).
Dust prawns in flour, dip, fry at 175–180 °C 1.5–2 min; drain on a rack.
Serve at once with tentsuyu, grated daikon and ginger. Oil weight = absorbed.
3aa0256a.al: 1 Gluten (soy sauce, tempura flour) · 2 Crustaceans (black tiger prawns) · 6 Soybeans (soy sauce). Check mirin label for 14 Sulphites.

fbebcf31.yl: Yield: 10 portions · 10 rolls × 8 pcs · Portion: 1 roll ≈ 220 g
c: Wash until clear; drain 30 min; cook covered 12 min, rest 10 min.
Fold in seasoned vinegar while fanning to body temperature; use within 4 h.
Spicy tuna: 5 mm dice, mix with mayo, sriracha, sesame oil and spring onion; keep 0–2 °C.
Half nori on a filmed mat; spread 130 g rice; sesame; flip.
Fill 60 g spicy tuna and cucumber batons; roll tight; cut 8 with a wet knife; serve within 15 min.
fbebcf31.al: 3 Eggs (mayonnaise) · 4 Fish (tuna loin) · 11 Sesame (sesame seeds, toasted sesame oil)

bbaf60c2.yl: Yield: 10 portions · Portion: 160 g raw beef + rice + vegetables ≈ 430 g
c: Cook rice the day before; spread and chill (dry grains fry better).
Teppan 200 °C: fry sliced garlic in butter to golden chips; keep half for garnish.
Scramble eggs, add rice, toss with two spatulas; soy around the edge to caramelise; spring onion.
Zones: hot 230–250 °C for beef, medium 180 °C for vegetables.
Vegetables first: onion, zucchini and shiitake with butter and soy; bean sprouts last 30 s.
Season beef; sear the block on all sides 1 min each; flambé with sake.
Cut 2.5 cm cubes on the plate; cook to the guest's choice (medium-rare core 54 °C); top with garlic chips.
Serve in order: vegetables, beef, rice; dip on the side.
bbaf60c2.st: Cooked rice for frying: 0–4 °C, 24 h. Dip: 0–4 °C, 72 h.
bbaf60c2.al: 1 Gluten (soy sauce) · 3 Eggs (eggs) · 6 Soybeans (soy sauce) · 7 Milk (butter). Check sake and mirin labels for 14 Sulphites.

0e0de81a.yl: Yield: 10 portions · Portion: 5 sashimi + 4 nigiri ≈ 240 g
c: Wash 4–5 times until clear; drain 30 min.
Cook covered 12 min on low, rest 10 min off heat.
Dissolve sugar and salt in vinegar; fold into hot rice in a hangiri with cutting strokes while fanning to body temperature.
Cover with a damp cloth; room temperature, use within 4 h.
Cut the loin into saku blocks 2.5 × 6 cm along the grain; keep at 0–2 °C.
Sashimi: hira-zukuri, 1 cm slices in one pull of the yanagiba, 15 g each.
Nigiri: 18 g rice; 15 g neta 7 × 3 cm × 6 mm; dab wasabi; shape with 2–3 light presses.
Plate 5 sashimi + 4 nigiri with wasabi and gari, soy on the side; serve within 15 min.
0e0de81a.st: Sushi rice: room temp, 4 h. Saku blocks: 0–2 °C, 24 h, wrapped.
0e0de81a.al: 1 Gluten (soy sauce) · 4 Fish (tuna loin) · 6 Soybeans (soy sauce). Gluten-free option: tamari.

aaa3550c.yl: Yield: 10 portions · Portion: 300 g (serve with jasmine rice)
c: Dry-toast coriander and cumin seeds; grind with pepper.
Pound hardest first: salt, lemongrass, galangal, green chilli; then shallot, garlic, coriander root, lime leaf; kapi last.
Pound 15–20 min to a smooth paste (a blender works with a little oil, but pounding gives more aroma).
'Crack' the coconut cream: simmer 5–8 min until the oil separates.
Fry the paste in it 3–4 min until fragrant.
Add sliced chicken, coat 2 min; add coconut milk, quartered eggplant and torn lime leaves.
Simmer 8–10 min, chicken core 75 °C; season with fish sauce and palm sugar.
Off the heat add basil and sliced red chilli; serve with jasmine rice.

60922276.yl: Yield: 10 portions · Portion: 320 g (serve with jasmine rice)
c: Cut beef 4 cm; simmer in coconut milk and water with cinnamon, cardamom and bay 1.5–2 h until tender.
Crack coconut cream; fry paste 4 min until fragrant.
Add the beef liquid and beef, potatoes in chunks and onion wedges; simmer 20 min.
Season with tamarind, palm sugar and fish sauce: sweet, sour, salty; add peanuts.
60922276.al: 2 Crustaceans (massaman curry paste) · 4 Fish (fish sauce) · 5 Peanuts (peanuts)

ce088ff8.yl: Yield: 10 portions · Portion: 320 g (cook 2 portions per wok)
c: Melt together on low heat; balance sour-sweet-salty; cool.
Soak noodles in warm water 30–40 min until pliable; drain.
Wok very hot: oil, shallot, garlic, tofu and dried shrimp 30 s; prawns 1 min.
Push aside, scramble egg; add noodles and sauce, toss 2 min (splash water if dry).
Add sprouts and chives 30 s; plate with peanuts, lime and chilli flakes on the side.
ce088ff8.al: 2 Crustaceans (black tiger prawns, dried shrimp) · 3 Eggs (eggs) · 4 Fish (fish sauce) · 5 Peanuts (peanuts) · 6 Soybeans (firm tofu)

c: Pound to order, 2 portions per batch
Peel papaya; shred into long thin strands; soak in ice water 10 min; drain well.
Dressing: dissolve palm sugar in fish sauce, lime juice and tamarind.
In a clay mortar pound garlic and chilli; add beans (bruise), dried shrimp, peanuts and halved tomatoes.
Add papaya and dressing; pound lightly and toss with a spoon 30 s.
Taste sour, sweet, salty, hot; serve at once (it releases water).
fe0deb5f.st: Shredded papaya: 0–4 °C in water, 24 h. Dressing: 0–4 °C, 5 days.

c: Peel prawns, keep tails on, devein; keep heads and shells.
Toast heads and shells in a dry pot 3 min until red; add water, bruised lemongrass, sliced galangal, torn lime leaves and shallots.
Bring stock to the boil; add mushrooms 2 min; whisk in nam prik pao and fish sauce.
Add prawns 1.5–2 min until just curled.
Off the heat add lime juice and crushed chillies (boiled lime turns bitter).
Taste: sour, then hot, salty, a touch sweet; coriander; serve at 80 °C or above.
0d64fef5.st: Stock: 0–4 °C, 48 h. Finish soup to order.
0d64fef5.al: 2 Crustaceans (tiger prawns, nam prik pao) · 4 Fish (fish sauce, nam prik pao). Lemongrass, galangal and lime leaves are for flavour, not eaten.

34032119.yl: Yield: 10 portions · Portion: 300 g (serve with rice or naan)
c: Cut thigh into 4 cm pieces; marinate 4–12 h at 0–4 °C.
Tandoor or 250 °C oven / grill 12–15 min until charred at the edges; core 75 °C.
Simmer tomatoes, water, soaked cashews, ginger, garlic, whole spices and chilli 20 min; remove cinnamon and cloves.
Blend very smooth, pass through a fine sieve; add butter, honey, garam masala and crushed methi; simmer 5 min; add cream.
Simmer tikka in the gravy 5 min; swirl in butter and cream; coriander; serve at 75 °C or above.
34032119.st: Gravy: 0–4 °C, 72 h. Finished dish: 0–4 °C, 48 h; reheat once to 75 °C.
34032119.al: 7 Milk (strained yoghurt, cream 35%, butter) · 8 Nuts (cashew nuts)

0b8bf6a1.yl: Yield: 10 portions · Portion: 200 g dhal + 30 g sambol
c: Rinse lentils; simmer with water, turmeric and half the onion 15 min until soft.
Add coconut milk and salt; simmer 5 min.
Tadka: coconut oil, mustard seeds until they pop, cumin, curry leaves, pandan, chilli, garlic and remaining onion until golden; pour over.
Grind onion, chilli, Maldive fish and salt; rub into coconut with lime by hand until red and moist.
0b8bf6a1.al: 4 Fish (maldive fish) · 10 Mustard (mustard seeds). Vegan option: sambol without Maldive fish.

6cc1ce5a.yl: Yield: 10 portions · Portion: 3 cutlets ≈ 270 g served
c: First marinade: ginger-garlic paste, 40 g lemon, salt, 10 g chilli; rub in, 30 min.
Second marinade: yoghurt, oil, remaining chilli and lemon, garam masala, cumin, crushed methi, turmeric; coat, 4–12 h at 0–4 °C.
Tandoor 300 °C+ on skewers 8–10 min, or very hot grill 3–4 min per side; core 60–63 °C; rest 3 min.
Blend herbs, chilli, ginger, lemon, sugar and salt with a little ice; fold into yoghurt.
Baste with ghee as it comes off the heat; sprinkle chaat masala.
Serve with onion rings, lemon and chutney.
Infuse bisque (TTK 23) with bruised lemongrass 10 min; strain; add coconut cream; reduce to coating; lime.
Boil water; whisk in cold butter piece by piece; hold at 60–65 °C (never boil).
Blanch tails 2 min, ice, shell whole; keep the meat raw in the centre.
Poach in beurre monté at 60 °C 6–8 min to core 57–60 °C.
Glaze baby vegetables; peas 1 min; pak choi seared.
Plate vegetables, lobster sliced in medallions, sauce frothed at the table.
9e0bffbd.al: 2 Crustaceans (lobster bisque, spiny lobster) · 7 Milk (lobster bisque, butter) · 9 Celery (lobster bisque) · 14 Sulphites (lobster bisque)

c: Roast half the squash 200 °C 25 min for depth; dice the rest.
Sweat onion and ginger in butter 5 min; add all squash, turmeric and stock; simmer 20 min.
Blend 2 min with coconut milk; pass through a fine sieve; season.
Plate: toasted seeds and crisp curry leaves in the bowl; pour velouté at the table; dots of coconut cream.
81bd10ae.al: 7 Milk (butter) · 9 Celery (vegetable stock). Vegetable stock contains celery.

c: Simmer 8 min to a syrup; strain.
Bake whole 200 °C 45 min; scoop; blend with butter and coconut milk; pass.
Score skin; salt; start skin side down in a cold pan; render 8–10 min on medium.
Turn 1 min; oven 180 °C 4–5 min to core 56 °C; rest 6 min; brush with glaze.
Sear halved pak choi 1 min; plate purée, sliced duck, pak choi, sesame.
fac75c72.al: 1 Gluten (soy sauce) · 6 Soybeans (soy sauce) · 7 Milk (butter) · 11 Sesame (sesame seeds)

5308c539.yl: Yield: 10 portions · Portion: 150 g consommé + 40 g tuna ≈ 195 g
c: Make garudhiya (rinse fish until clear, start cold, skim, 12 min simmer); strain through muslin.
For crystal clarity: chill, then pass through a coffee filter or agar clarify.
Blend leaves and oil at high speed 6 min to 70 °C; strain through a coffee filter; cool on ice (keeps green).
Sear tuna 15 s per side; slice 4 pieces per bowl.
Place tuna, brunoise onion and chilli in a warm bowl; pour 150 g consommé at 85 °C at the table.
Drops of curry leaf oil; a fine zest of lime.
Cook rice in coconut milk and water 18 min; press 2 cm in a lined tray; chill 2 h; cut 10 and pan-fry crisp.
Reduce wine, shallot and curry leaves to 2 tbsp; add curry powder and coconut cream, boil 1 min.
Whisk in cold diced butter off and on the heat; strain; lime; hold at 60 °C.
Pickle: papaya fine julienne in warm vinegar, sugar and 3 g salt, 1 h.
Portion fish 150 g, score skin, salt; pan-fry skin side 4 min pressing flat, turn 1 min; core 55–58 °C.
Rice cake, fish on top, sauce around, papaya and herbs.
5a17f339.st: Rice cake: 0–4 °C, 48 h. Beurre blanc: max 2 h.
5a17f339.al: 4 Fish (grouper / job fish fillet) · 7 Milk (butter) · 14 Sulphites (white wine). Check wine label for 14 Sulphites.

c: Boil water, sugar and agar 1 min; add lime; set in the fridge 30 min; blend to a smooth gel; pipe bottle.
Mas huni: very fine brunoise onion and chilli, rubbed with salt and lime; mix with flaked tuna and coconut.
Fry curry leaves crisp in oil 10 s; drain.
Fill tartlets with 10 g mas huni; 3 dots of lime gel; 1 crisp curry leaf. Fill at the last minute (soggy shells).
b0e7d2ed.al: 1 Gluten (tartlet shells) · 3 Eggs (tartlet shells) · 4 Fish (smoked tuna or kingfish) · 7 Milk (tartlet shells)

c: Blend 20 s with prawn trim (optional); strain; keep at 0–2 °C.
Blanch prawns 30 s and ice (or use frozen-for-parasites raw); cut in 1.5 cm pieces.
Mix prawns with salt 1 min; add tiger's milk 2–3 min only.
Add diced mango, avocado, red onion julienne and chilli; coriander; serve in a chilled bowl at once.
15a41ef1.st: Tiger's milk: 0–2 °C, 24 h. Ceviche: mix to order.

c: Dry-roast whole spices 2–4 min; cool; grind with turmeric.
Fry curry leaves; onion 8 min; garlic, ginger, curry powder 1 min; tomato 5 min; coconut milk 10 min; blend smooth; lime.
Cut thick 'steaks' and florets; brush with oil, curry powder and salt; roast 220 °C 20–25 min until charred at the edges.
Dry chickpeas; roast 200 °C 25 min until crunchy.
Sauce in the plate, cauliflower steak, chickpeas, diced mango, coriander.
57c65947.al: None of the 14 declared allergens. Vegan.

c: Simmer florets in milk 15 min until very soft; drain (keep milk); blend with butter 3 min, adding milk to a silky purée.
Cook butter to noisette (hazelnut, 150 °C); add curry powder 10 s off the heat; add soaked raisins, capers and lemon.
Dry scallops on paper; salt 1 min before cooking.
Very hot pan, thin oil: sear 90 s without moving until deep golden, turn, 30 s; core 45–50 °C, translucent centre.
Swipe 40 g purée; 3 scallops; spoon curry butter; micro herbs.
80de3346.st: Purée: 0–4 °C, 48 h. Scallops: 0–2 °C on paper, 24 h.

c: Sweat shallot in oil; toast rice 2 min; wine.
Add hot stock ladle by ladle 16–17 min; stir in ink at 10 min.
Off the heat beat in cold butter and parmesan (mantecatura); loose, all'onda.
Infuse saffron in hot stock 10 min; reduce by half; add cream; blend in butter; froth to serve.
Portion 130 g; score skin; dry well; salt.
Pan-fry skin side 3–4 min pressing flat until crisp; turn 30 s; core 55 °C.
Risotto in a shallow bowl, fish skin up, saffron foam beside.
638574af.st: Cook to order (par-cook risotto 12 min, spread, finish to order).
638574af.al: 4 Fish (fish stock, sea bass fillet) · 7 Milk (butter, parmesan, cream 35%) · 12 Molluscs (squid ink) · 14 Sulphites (white wine). Check wine label for 14 Sulphites.

c: Char whole aubergines over flame until collapsed; peel; drain 30 min.
Chop fine; mix with yoghurt, garlic, lemon, oil and salt.
Season racks; sear fat side 3 min; roast 200 °C 10–12 min to core 56 °C; rest 8 min.
Brush with mustard; press crust on; flash under the grill 1 min.
Jus: deglaze roasting tray with stock, reduce to 150 g.
Plate aubergine quenelle, 3 cutlets, mint yoghurt dots, jus.
a1661b60.al: 1 Gluten (breadcrumbs) · 7 Milk (strained yoghurt) · 8 Nuts (pistachios) · 9 Celery (beef stock) · 10 Mustard (dijon mustard)

c: Sedate in ice; blanch tails 60–90 s in boiling salted water; ice bath; remove shell.
Roll each tail tight in film, freeze 1 h until firm; slice 2 mm.
Avocado: purée with lime and salt; pipe 5 dots.
Lay 60 g lobster slices flat on a chilled plate, overlapping.
Whisk yuzu, lime and olive oil; brush over; salt flakes.
Finish with 3 g caviar quenelle, chives and micro herbs; serve at 2–4 °C.

5084fec0.yl: Yield: 10 portions · Portion: 120 g Wagyu ≈ 280 g
c: Sweat shallots, add wine and reduce by ¾; add stock, reduce to 400 g, coating a spoon; mount with butter.
Blend until very smooth; pass; pipe bottle.
Cut 10 cylinders 5 cm × 4 cm; colour both flat sides in butter 4 min each.
Add stock, garlic and thyme half way up; oven 180 °C 25–30 min, basting, until a knife slides in.
Temper 30 min; render the fat cap; sear 1.5 min per side; rest 5 min; core 52–54 °C.
Slice 120 g; plate with fondant, black garlic dots and jus; salt flakes on the meat.
5084fec0.st: Jus: 0–4 °C, 5 days. Fondant: cook per service.
5084fec0.al: 7 Milk (butter) · 9 Celery (beef stock, chicken stock) · 14 Sulphites (red wine). Check wine label for 14 Sulphites.

c: Cut 4 × 4 cm logs; season; roll in sesame.
Sear on a smoking pan 15 s per side; straight into ice water 10 s; dry.
Slice 8 mm; plate 90 g fanned over avocado cream (avocado, lime, salt blended).
Spoon ponzu at the table; spring onion and micro herbs.
178cc7f1.al: 1 Gluten (soy sauce) · 4 Fish (tuna loin) · 6 Soybeans (soy sauce) · 11 Sesame (sesame seeds). Check mirin label for 14 Sulphites.

cc3b6daa.yl: 50 guests · 90 g per guest · K 1.1 · Batch ≈ 5 kg
c: Soak dried chillies; blend everything to a smooth paste.
Cut beef 4 cm (raw 5.5 kg → ≈ 3.3 kg cooked meat).
Fry paste in oil 10 min until fragrant and darker.
Add beef, coconut milk, lime leaves, spices; simmer uncovered 2.5–3 h, stirring more as it dries.
Add kerisik, tamarind, palm sugar, salt; cook until the sauce clings and the oil separates, dark brown.

d1760998.yl: 50 guests · 90 g per guest · K 1.0 · Batch ≈ 4.5 kg
c: Heat until sugar dissolves; keep warm.
Portion fillet 90–100 g; lay on perforated GN over half the ginger and spring onion.
Steam 100 °C 6–8 min to 60 °C core (raw 4.6 kg → 4.0 kg).
Transfer to serving pan; top with julienne ginger, spring onion, coriander.
Pour smoking-hot oil over the aromatics, then warm soy. Small trays every 20 min.
d1760998.st: Raw fish 0–2 °C, cook same day; do not hold steamed fish beyond 1 h.
d1760998.al: 1 Gluten (soy sauce) · 4 Fish (grouper / job fish fillet) · 6 Soybeans (soy sauce)

6424480a.yl: 50 guests · take rate ≈ 40 % = 20 bowls · Bowl: 300 g + 30 g condiments · K 1.0
c: Rinse rice; freeze wet overnight optional (cracks grains, faster cook).
Simmer rice with stock, water and sliced ginger 75–90 min, stirring, until silky.
Poach chicken 15 min to 75 °C core; shred and fold in; season with salt, pepper, sesame oil.
Hold in a soup kettle at 75 °C; thin with hot stock as it thickens.
Fine julienne ginger, sliced spring onion and coriander in small bowls on ice.
Soy and chilli oil in bottles; fried shallots kept dry in a sealed tub.
6424480a.al: 1 Gluten (fried shallots, soy sauce) · 6 Soybeans (soy sauce) · 9 Celery (chicken stock) · 11 Sesame (toasted sesame oil)

3a98af6a.yl: 50 guests · 130 g per guest · K 1.2 · Batch ≈ 8 kg (starch of the night)
c: Marinate chicken with yoghurt, paste, spices, salt, lemon 4 h at 0–4 °C.
Fry sliced onion in oil until deep golden (birista, 1.5 kg → 400 g); keep a third for layering.
Cook chicken with two-thirds of the birista 20 min, half done.
Soak rice 30 min; boil in salted water with whole spices 6 min, 70 % done; drain.
Layer in 2 GN 1/1: chicken, herbs, birista, rice; saffron milk and ghee on top.
Seal with foil and lid; dum in oven 160 °C 35 min, core 75 °C; rest 10 min; open at the station.
3a98af6a.st: Serve within 2 h; do not re-chill cooked rice.

bd793bcd.yl: 50 guests · 100 g per guest · K 1.0 · Batch ≈ 5 kg
c: Loosen noodles with a splash of water.
Teppan or wok in 3 batches: chicken strips 4 min to 75 °C; onion, carrot, cabbage 2 min.
Noodles and sprouts 2 min; sauce, toss until coated and slightly caramelised.
Finish with aonori; beni shoga on the side.
bd793bcd.al: 1 Gluten (oyster sauce, soy sauce, yakisoba noodles) · 4 Fish (worcestershire sauce) · 6 Soybeans (oyster sauce, soy sauce) · 12 Molluscs (oyster sauce) · 14 Sulphites (worcestershire sauce)

1dd0f201.yl: 50 guests · take rate ≈ 40 % = 20 bowls · Bowl: 450 g · K 1.0
c: Soak chillies 20 min; blend all to a paste; fry 10 min on low heat until the oil separates.
Fry paste 2 min, add stock, simmer 15 min; add coconut milk and tofu puffs, 5 min; season. Hold 75 °C.
Poach chicken to 75 °C, slice; boil eggs 8 min, halve; soak vermicelli.
To order: blanch noodles and sprouts 30 s, prawns 2 min in the broth.
Bowl: noodles, chicken, prawns, egg half, 250 ml broth, herbs, lime, sambal.
1dd0f201.al: 1 Gluten (egg noodles) · 2 Crustaceans (shrimp paste, black tiger prawns) · 3 Eggs (egg noodles, eggs) · 4 Fish (fish sauce) · 6 Soybeans (tofu puffs) · 9 Celery (chicken stock)

234a38fe.yl: 50 guests · 80 g per guest · K 1.0 · Batch ≈ 4 kg
c: Soak dal and beans overnight; pressure-cook 25 min (or simmer 2 h) until very soft.
Fry ginger-garlic in half the butter; add chilli and passata 10 min.
Add dal with its liquid; simmer 45 min on low heat, stirring, mashing some lentils.
Finish with cream, remaining butter, garam masala and crushed methi.

afc0255f.yl: 50 guests · take rate ≈ 40 % = 20 orders · Order: 2 halves ≈ 250 g · K 1.0
c: Reduce vinegar and water by half; cool.
Whisk yolks with reduction over a bain-marie to ribbon stage, 65–70 °C.
Off heat, whisk in warm butter (55–60 °C) in a thin stream; season with lemon, salt, cayenne.
Hold at 60–63 °C in a bain-marie, max 2 h; discard after.
Mise en place: 40 eggs pre-poached 2 min in 80–85 °C water with vinegar, into iced water; hold 0–4 °C, max 4 h.
To order: refresh eggs 45 s in 75 °C water; toast muffin halves; warm ham on the plancha.
Build: muffin, ham, egg, 40 g hollandaise, chives. Out in 3 min.
afc0255f.st: Pre-poached eggs: 0–4 °C, same service. Hollandaise: never cooled and reused.
afc0255f.al: 1 Gluten (english muffins) · 3 Eggs (egg yolks, eggs) · 7 Milk (clarified butter) · 14 Sulphites (white wine vinegar)

ee37550d.yl: 50 guests · 3 prawns ≈ 120 g per guest · K 1.0 · 150 pcs
c: Soften butter; mix in chopped garlic, chilli, parsley, lime; roll; chill.
Split along the back, devein, keep head and shell; skewer 3 per skewer.
Oil, salt, paprika; grill shell side 2 min, flesh side 1–2 min to 63 °C core (raw 7 kg → 6 kg).
Brush with melted garlic-chilli butter; serve with lime. Grill in small batches to the queue.
ee37550d.st: Raw 0–2 °C, display on ice max 1 h before grilling.

a45b07bb.yl: 50 guests · take rate ≈ 45 % = 22 bowls · Bowl: 250 ml · K 1.0
c: Soak wood ear 30 min; julienne all solids.
Bring stock to the boil; add chicken, mushrooms, bamboo 5 min, tofu 2 min.
Season soy; thicken with slaked starch to light coating.
Off the boil, pour beaten egg in a thin stream, stir once for ribbons.
Vinegar, white pepper, chilli oil, sesame oil at the end (vinegar fades if boiled). Spring onion on top.
a45b07bb.st: 0–4 °C, 48 h; add vinegar and pepper again after reheating.
a45b07bb.al: 1 Gluten (chinkiang black vinegar, soy sauce) · 3 Eggs (eggs) · 6 Soybeans (firm tofu, soy sauce) · 9 Celery (chicken stock) · 11 Sesame (toasted sesame oil)

4745490c.yl: 50 guests · 90 g per guest · K 1.2 · Batch ≈ 5.5 kg
c: Whisk together; stir again before use.
Dice chicken 2 cm; marinate with soy, Shaoxing and starch 20 min (raw 3.5 kg → 2.8 kg cooked).
Wok in 4 batches: sear chicken 3–4 min to 75 °C core; remove.
Oil, chillies and Sichuan pepper 20 s (do not burn); garlic, ginger, peppers 1 min.
Return chicken, add sauce, toss until glossy; peanuts and spring onion last.
4745490c.st: Serve within 2 h; peanuts added at the end to stay crisp.
4745490c.al: 1 Gluten (soy sauce, chinkiang black vinegar, shaoxing wine) · 5 Peanuts (peanuts) · 6 Soybeans (soy sauce) · 11 Sesame (toasted sesame oil) · 14 Sulphites (shaoxing wine). Peanut dish: label clearly, separate tongs.

47d6099c.yl: 50 guests · 120 g per guest · K 1.0 · Batch ≈ 6 kg + eggs to order
c: Cook, spread on trays, chill uncovered to 4 °C within 2 h; cover; use next day (dry grains fry best).
Pound shallot, garlic, sambal and toasted shrimp paste to a paste.
Wok in 2 batches: oil, diced chicken 3 min; paste 1 min; eggs scrambled; rice, toss 3 min very hot.
Season with kecap manis and salt; spring onion. Garnish line: fried egg to order, cucumber, tomato, krupuk, fried shallots.
47d6099c.st: Cooked rice: 0–4 °C, 24 h. Fried rice: serve, do not re-chill.

a91796a1.yl: 50 guests · 70 g per guest · K 1.0 · Batch ≈ 3.5 kg
c: Blanch spinach 1 min, ice; blend smooth (3 kg → 1.5 kg).
Cumin in ghee 20 s; onion 8 min golden; ginger-garlic, chilli, tomato 5 min.
Add purée, simmer 5 min only (keeps green); season.
Pan-sear paneer cubes; fold in with cream, garam masala, methi.
a91796a1.st: Purée: 0–4 °C, 24 h. Finished: serve same day.

Roast 220 °C 20 min, then 160 °C to 58 °C core (≈ 1.5 h); rest 30 min, carry-over to 62 °C.
Carve to order across the grain under a heat lamp, 3 slices ≈ 90 g.
Batch · 1500 g jus + 250 g mint sauce
Roast veg in the lamb tray; tomato paste 2 min; deglaze wine, reduce; add stock and roasting juices, reduce to 1.5 kg; thicken lightly; strain.
Mint sauce: chop mint, add sugar and hot vinegar; stand 30 min.
3919628d.st: Carved meat not held over 2 h; leftovers chilled whole, cold buffet next day.

cf9cf672.yl: 50 guests · 90 g per guest · K 1.3 (popular) · Batch ≈ 5.9 kg
c: Boil sake and mirin 1 min; add soy and sugar; reduce by a third to a light syrup.
Cut 70 g pieces (65 pieces, K 1.3); brush with oil.
